findings.summary: S12 as written cannot reach the proposed 112 funding.
findings.evidence: S12 open: funding = face + reserve; open(90,10) gives exactly 110 with invoice duty 100 and reserve duty 10. ERR-22: S12 has no extra transfer and no reserve-return action. Funding 112 against duties 100/10 therefore needs a program change, not an S12 parameter.
findings.requiredFix: Label the 112 view only as a PROPOSED application policy that S12 does not provide or enforce (invoiceRules IR-05). Never present it as a selectable S12 action or as source behavior.

findings.summary: Slider domain must follow the literal S12 partial preconditions.
findings.evidence: S12 partial: requires opened and amount > 0; requires amount < opening. With opening invoice duty 100, accepted amounts are 1 to 99. Paying 100 is the separate finish action, which has no fee call.
findings.requiredFix: Bound the slider to integers 1 to 99. Show 0 and 100 only as labelled refusals, never as accepted source actions (IR-02, IR-03). Any finish control needs its own fee-free, Close-blocked display, and this contribution does not authorize one.

findings.summary: Three illustrated Strand roles risk implying existing separate producers and a consumer.
findings.evidence: CONCEPT: genuine composition needs separately identified supported relations, matching statements and an actual required-set consumer; naming source expressions fee and liability does not create independent producers. SEC06-P01/P02 are PROPOSED and no Web consumer exists in the packet.
findings.requiredFix: Apply diagramRules DR-01 and DR-02: label the roles as illustrated, with separate relations and a required-set consumer unestablished. Draw signed intents, UTxOs, claim outputs and validators as non-Strands.

findings.summary: The reviewed approved-claim phrase 'on-chain Groth16 check' could be read as an observed result.
findings.evidence: SECURITY-REVIEW §9: 'A claim is issued only after an on-chain Groth16 check' is scoped to V2 source with K10 as one local finite result; no on-chain transaction is recorded (ERR-17).
findings.requiredFix: Use the card wording 'the C2 claim policy checks a Groth16 proof' under the V2 SOURCE READING stage, with the maturity note that no on-chain transaction is recorded.

findings.summary: The dispatch label K6 does not appear in the supplied inputs.
findings.evidence: Supplied records name K10 for S08 /cases/0 and K4H for host tests. No supplied text defines K6.
findings.requiredFix: Refer to the recorded roundtrip as S07 in page copy. Treat any K6 mapping as unverified until root supplies it.

findings.summary: Proposed full backing does not complete the S12 lifecycle.
findings.evidence: ERR-22: after finish, escrow holds 8 against reserve duty 10 and the nonzero reserve duty blocks V2 Close. Under the proposed 112 policy, escrow holds 10 against 10, but the duty is still nonzero and no discharge action exists.
findings.requiredFix: Never show closed, complete or reserve returned (IR-08).
